svg.aria-label: Token Cost Allocation: requests go from your application through the LiteLLM proxy to the model provider. The Vantage callback sends token usage and tags to the Vantage collector, which uploads them to Vantage. Vantage divides the provider bill by token share and shows Cost Reports by team, user, and customer.
